tldr: The Sun in Gemini: identity built through curiosity, language, and connection.
body: With the Sun in Gemini, the core self strengthens through learning, asking, translating, and staying mentally alive. You are here to gather experience and turn it into useful understanding.
gift: Communication, adaptability, wit, and the ability to connect ideas and people.
challenge: Scattered focus, inconsistency, and using more information to avoid a clear choice.
note: Authored from approved project planet-through-sign material.
